top_3_by_cost_of_inaction.why: At the plan's own 500-account scale the store can evict a live export, drop its completion and leak capacity; the campaign stalls silently and the new Jobs view loses the row instead of showing a failure.

A failed live read renders as live 0/missing 0/'complete'. That is the console's first question answered wrongly, and it can hide undownloaded Hidden photos holding crypto; the acceptance never tests the failure case.

Every deploy or crash strands all in-flight jobs as 'unknown' with no requeue; recovery depends on an operator noticing and manually re-running Export missing, while P0-1 promises a durable, retryable list.

would_drop_if_forced.reason: Most contingent: it assumes bulk replays per-account events, which a single server-side command would avoid. DA-7 (last message not persisted) is the next weakest but is a direct P0-1 field.
